verdict.rationale: Radar's rules and value lists let you apply an action (block, 3DS, allow) to many transactions matching criteria at once, and the review queue is designed to avoid per-payment manual review, which is a form of bulk automation (stripe-radar-docs-1, stripe-radar-docs-3, stripe-radar-docs-10, stripe-radar-docs-18). However, the API surface shown only exposes single-item operations (e.g. POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve) with no documented batch/bulk endpoint for approving, rejecting, or acting on multiple reviews or transactions simultaneously. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API (e.g. approve many reviews in one call), evidence of programmatic multi-item selection, and independent confirmation that rule-based automation scales to large volumes without manual tuning.
